book.meridian_peddler.legwork.note: Hands may hold anything. You must stand on the ground. Better boots kick harder; each form wears the boots once.
technique.meridian_peddler.snap_kick.not: one quick kick to the leg; Roundhouse or Triple Kick can follow
technique.meridian_peddler.push_kick.not: one push to the body that shoves the target away
a half circle in front, then behind, tripping up to five within 3 blocks; Axe Kick can follow
training form: hold a stance for 30 s without striking; leg endurance grows afterwards
technique.meridian_peddler.roundhouse.no: one heavy kick to the head; Whirlwind can follow
technique.meridian_peddler.triple_kick.n: three kicks at one target, from leg up to head
technique.meridian_peddler.mule_kick.not: a kick backwards that shoves away up to two targets behind you
technique.meridian_peddler.flying_kick.n: two steps forward, then a flying kick; Whirlwind can follow
technique.meridian_peddler.axe_kick.note: a downward kick that a shield cannot block
technique.meridian_peddler.whirlwind.not: only after Roundhouse or Flying Kick; a half circle in front, then behind, on up to six targets within 3.5 blocks
advancements.meridian_peddler.cultivator: Every trick of the road and the ambush mastered: flying kicks come down like axes, and a fierce whirlwind sweep scatters everyone closing in.
codex.intro.meridian_peddler.legwork: Footwork honed by peddlers on desolate tracks: kicking stone, sweeping sand, whipping from the hip—breaking every ambush with legs alone.
codex.power.meridian_peddler.road: Settle your stance low and shove foes back with the sole of the foot. Dropping low across desert sand, a ground sweep trips everyone crowding in.
codex.power.meridian_peddler.ambush: Whip the leg around with a twist of the hips, peppering vitals on a single foot, or kick backward with both heels like a startled llama.
codex.power.meridian_peddler.journey: A flying kick breaks the path ahead, followed by an axe kick brought down on the skull, and a whirlwind sweep that scatters everyone closing in.
